audit.whatIsWrong: Chart disagreed with the already-audited mirror on four rows, and the diff enum said HARD while breakdown.difficulty and report[14] both said 'Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10'.
audit.why: Mirror (singed__ziggs) records Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Singed / Singed / Singed / Skill: Ziggs owns levels 1-3 on range, then Singed's proxy game, Insanity Potion and Rylai's take the middle stretch back. The diff token should agree with the two prose fields that quote 5.5/10.
audit.corrected: Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Singed / Singed / Singed / Skill, with diff set to EVEN to match its own rating text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a Ziggs spike ('R snipes the proxying Singed off the map for free'), which is both the wrong side and unverifiable.
audit.why: Insanity Potion is a flat 100-second cooldown that grants combat stats and makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds. That is a genuine Singed spike; Mega Inferno Bomb sniping a proxying Singed is a hopeful claim, not a mechanic. Mirror lists Singed's spikes as 4-5 proxy, level 6 Insanity Potion, Rylai's.
audit.corrected: At 6 Insanity Potion runs you down and Grievous-Wounds you — a flat 100 seconds, so back off the poison rather than trading through it.
sources: kits: singed R cd 100, antiHeal flag, text

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling is treated as a long-range threat with a 'fifteen-second' cooldown, and the root condition is never stated. The reduced-damage rule on repeat mine detonations is also missing.
audit.why: Fling is 125 range on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 — he has to be on top of you — and Riot's text says the flip only ROOTS if the target lands in Mega Adhesive (1000 range, 17/16/15/14/13s). Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s at every rank and 'successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage', so the first mine is the one that pays.
audit.corrected: Fling reaches just 125 units and is 10s at rank 1; it only roots if the flip drops you into Mega Adhesive, so never stand where the goo already is. Your minefield is a flat 16s and repeat detonations on one target deal less — make the first mine count.
sources: kits: singed E range 125 cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 + Adhesive root clause, W range 1000 cd 17-13
kits: ziggs E cd 16 + reduced-damage text

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d called Fling a fifteen-second cooldown.
audit.why: It is 10 seconds at rank 1 — the page was selling a five-second window that does not exist.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you kite and chunk while his Poison Trail can't reach you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 he proxies and farms where your Q simply cannot follow.

edits.before: Level 6 R snipes the proxying Singed off the map for free.
edits.after: At 6 Insanity Potion runs you down and Grievous-Wounds you.

edits.before: First item lets your poke outpace his sustain and stay dominant.
edits.after: First item, his slows and health let him simply walk you down.

edits.before: Self-peel with W and E denies his Fling, keeping you ahead into 2 items.
edits.after: Two items in your self-peel holds, but he has already warped the map.

edits.before: Singed wants to run at you and fling; answer with E Hexplosive Minefield on your own feet so his Fling drops you into a mine carpet, and W Satchel to blast yourself away the instant he flips you.
edits.after: Singed wants to fling you; lay Hexplosive Minefield on your own feet so the flip drops him into it, then Satchel out — repeat detonations on one target deal less, so make the first mine count.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb catches a proxying Singed as he pushes waves in — you can snipe him off the map even when he refuses to fight, and punish his low base health.
edits.after: Insanity Potion is a flat 100 seconds and makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — while it runs he walks you down, so Satchel out early instead of trading through the poison.

edits.before: The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Fling reaches just 125 units, so he must touch you — and it only roots if the flip lands you in Mega Adhesive.

edits.before: Singed burns Fling on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Singed burns Fling on nothing — take the ten-second invitation.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Satchel like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 125 range and 10 seconds at rank 1, and it roots only if it drops you in Mega Adhesive — never stand where the goo already is. - Guard your W Satchel like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.

notes: Corrected a wrong hard number the page sold as a window: Fling is 10s at rank 1, written as fifteen. Added the root condition (Fling only roots into Mega Adhesive) and the reduced-damage rule on repeat mine detonations. Chart aligned to the mirror over four rows with matching whys, and diff flipped HARD->EVEN because both prose ratings on the same page already said 'Even matchup — 5.5/10'. Per the mirror's flag I wrote nothing about Satchel Charge bypassing resistances: the percentHealth flag contradicts Riot's description, and _missing/singed.json builds a 'resistances-invalidated' headline on that misfire. UNVERIFIED, left alone: Mega Adhesive grounds, and grounding shuts off dashes — whether it also stops Satchel Charge's self-knockback (a displacement, not a dash) is not answerable from the kits, so I made no claim either way.
